The reflection in the background is indistinct and 'mushy,' lacking the sharp geometric correspondence expected from a reflective surface, though this could also be due to extreme shallow depth of field.
The boundary where the fingers grip the lighter is slightly soft and ill-defined, with the plastic casing appearing to merge subtly into the skin tone rather than having a crisp edge.
